name: marcat
description: Local-first Windows marketing workspace for indie-game teams: Steam analytics, multi-platform creator discovery, outreach CRM, and an AI copilot.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @marcat/db && npm run build -w @marcat/core
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w @marcat/mcp-server && npm run gen:mcp
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @marcat/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:mcp && npm run build -w @marcat/desktop
scripts.package: npm run verify:version && npm run verify:public-data && npm run prepare:release-docs && npm run build:packages && npm run build:mcp && npm run prepare:release-output && npm run package -w @marcat/desktop && npm run stage:release && npm run verify:release && npm run finalize:release
scripts.test:migrations: node scripts/migtest.cjs && node scripts/activity-migtest.cjs && node scripts/workspace-migration-test.cjs && node scripts/youtube-storage-migration-test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @marcat/mcp-server && npm run test:task-graph && npm run test:storefront && npm run test:comments && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:mcp-v2 && npm run test:mcp-startup && npm run test:mcp-http && npm run test:transport && npm run test:concurrency && npm run test:creator-outreach && npm run test:youtube-discovery
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
